title: Parse a key=value line
hints: line.split(";") gives you the fields; strip each one and skip the empty ones before doing anything else.
field.partition("=") returns (key, sep, value) and splits on the first '=' only; an empty sep means there was no '='.
Assign result[key.strip()] = value.strip() inside the loop; a later assignment to the same key overwrites the earlier one for free.
